# Document the design system

Find the project's canonical design documentation before drafting. Trace colors, type roles, spacing, and repeated components to their source tokens and actual usage. Record each durable guideline with the relevant source. Treat descriptions of brand personality and visual preferences as proposals until supported by existing guidance or confirmed by the user.

Update the existing canonical document when authorized. Use the project's conventions for machine-readable tokens and keep unsupported sections out. Record exceptions where they affect implementation. For a new project, label agreed design choices separately from implementation evidence.
